Name: Brysinnbo's Thistles
Author: Brysinnbo
Description:
Hello! This is my first mod that I just got working. This mod is modeled after [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884]slimerrain's Grain Overhaull[/url] (check them out!).

With this mod, you will be able to grow and harvest thistle flowers. Future
endeavors include the ability to create Thistle Honey.


Thistle Flowers: Sell Price 20g
Thistle Seeds: Price 10g, available at Pierre's
Thistle Honey: Sell Price 140g

Thistles Crops take 5 days to grow and can be harvested by hand (not scythe).
Flowers will bloom again every other day after maturing.
Nearby beehives will create Thistle Honey

Current Issues:
Thistle Flowers can only be sold via shipping bin
Thistle Honey still uses the vanilla skin

Downloads.Description: Updates to fix honey creation bug. Nearby beehives will produce Thistle Honey. Thistle Honey icon yet to be replaced over vanilla skin.

Manifest.Name: Brysinnbo's Thistles
Manifest.Description: Adds thistles as crops (flowers). Can be used as a source for honey.
